description:
Title: Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna

The robot receives an order.
It asks whether the customer wants a menu or just the burger.
If he wants a menu, the robot starts preparing the drink, which depending on the size can take a variable amount of time.
While doing so, he asks if you want fries or wedges.
If you want fries, he prepares the fries; if you want wedges, he prepares wedges.
Again the duration varies depending on the size fries/wedges order.
After that, he prepares the burger, and gives you enthusiastic status updates every 30 seconds.
Depending on the number of ingredients, the duration for creating the burger varies.
Your order is delivered via a conveyor belt.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_BurgerSeller" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/burger-seller">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MenuQuestion" name="Menu or burger question"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MenuChoice" name="Menu or burger choice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SidesQuestion" name="Fries or wedges question"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SidesChoice" name="Fries or wedges choice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StatusUpdate" name="Enthusiastic status update"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BurgerSeller">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Robot" name="Robotic burger seller" processRef="Process_Robot"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Order" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="StartEvent_Order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MenuQuestion" name="Menu or burger question" sourceRef="Task_AskMenuChoice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMenuQuestion" messageRef="Message_MenuQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MenuChoice" name="Menu or burger choice" sourceRef="Task_SendMenuChoice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice" messageRef="Message_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SidesQuestion" name="Fries or wedges question" sourceRef="Task_AskSidesChoice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSidesQuestion" messageRef="Message_SidesQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SidesChoice" name="Fries or wedges choice" sourceRef="Task_SendSidesChoice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSidesChoice" messageRef="Message_SidesChoice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StatusUpdate" name="Enthusiastic status update" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer order interaction" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Customer" name="Ready to place order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveMenuQuestion" name="Receive menu or burger question" messageRef="Message_MenuQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseMenuOption" name="Choose menu or just the burger"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMenuChoice" name="Send menu or burger choice" messageRef="Message_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerMenuChoice" name="Does the customer want a menu?"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSidesQuestion" name="Receive fries or wedges question" messageRef="Message_SidesQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseSidesOption" name="Choose fries or wedges"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSidesChoice" name="Send fries or wedges choice" messageRef="Message_SidesChoice"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CustomerMenu" name="Menu choice provided"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CustomerBurgerOnly" name="Burger-only choice provided"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Start_PlaceOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_Customer" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_PlaceOrder_ReceiveQuestion" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMenuQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_ReceiveQuestion_Choose" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveMenuQuestion" targetRef="Task_ChooseMenuOption"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Choose_SendMenu" sourceRef="Task_ChooseMenuOption" targetRef="Task_SendMenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_SendMenu_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_SendMenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerMenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Menu_ReceiveSides" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerMenuChoice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSidesQuestion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerWantsMenu</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_BurgerOnly_End" name="Just the burger" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerMenuChoice" targetRef="EndEvent_CustomerBurgerOnly">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerWantsJustBurger</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_ReceiveSides_Choose" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSidesQuestion" targetRef="Task_ChooseSidesOption"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_ChooseSides_Send" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSidesOption" targetRef="Task_SendSidesChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_SendSides_End" sourceRef="Task_SendSidesChoice" targetRef="EndEvent_CustomerMenu"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Robot" name="Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Order" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskMenuChoice" name="Ask whether the customer wants a menu or just the burger" messageRef="Message_MenuQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice" name="Receive menu or burger choice" messageRef="Message_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MenuChoice" name="Does the customer want a menu?"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuParallelSplit" name="Prepare drink and ask about sides"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the drink size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskSidesChoice" name="Ask whether the customer wants fries or wedges" messageRef="Message_SidesQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSidesChoice" name="Receive fries or wedges choice" messageRef="Message_SidesChoice"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SidesChoice" name="Does the customer want fries or wedges?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the size of the fries order.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the size of the wedges order.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SidesMerge" name="Side preparation complete"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuParallelJoin" name="Drink and side ready"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BurgerMerge" name="Continue to prepare burger"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the number of ingredients.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_StatusUpdates" name="Give status updates every 30 seconds" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_StatusTimer" name="Every 30 seconds" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_Status">
          <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">R/PT30S</bpmn:timeCycle>
        </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatusUpdate" name="Give enthusiastic status update" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StatusUpdate" name="Status update sent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusTimer_SendUpdate" sourceRef="StartEvent_StatusTimer" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendUpdate_StatusEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate" targetRef="EndEvent_StatusUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_AskMenu" sourceRef="StartEvent_Order" targetRef="Task_AskMenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskMenu_ReceiveChoice" sourceRef="Task_AskMenuChoice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveChoice_MenuGateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuChoice_Menu" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuParallelSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerWantsMenu</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuChoice_BurgerOnly" name="Just the burger" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerWantsJustBurger</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuSplit_Drink" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuSplit_AskSides" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_AskSidesChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Drink_MenuJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gateway_MenuParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskSides_ReceiveChoice" sourceRef="Task_AskSidesChoice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSidesChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveSides_SidesGateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSidesChoice" targetRef="Gateway_SidesChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SidesChoice_Fries" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gateway_SidesChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerWantsFries</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SidesChoice_Wedges" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gateway_SidesChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerWantsWedges</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fries_SidesMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gateway_SidesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wedges_SidesMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gateway_SidesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SidesMerge_MenuJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_SidesMerge" targetRef="Gateway_MenuParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuJoin_BurgerMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuParallelJoin" targetRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerMerge_PrepareBurger" sourceRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareBurger_Deliver" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deliver_End" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderDelivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
